conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new and there is a Capital Markets Update the same morning, so there is room for a guidance-scale move (abs 9%). The direction is close to a coin flip. The company's ~NOK 7.5bn 2026 revenue guide needs H2 revenue up about 30% y/y and sits well above the 3-analyst consensus of NOK 6.73bn, so a cut is probable but mostly priced. The 2028 >NOK 10bn target looks unreachable against 2027 consensus of NOK 7.02bn and is likely to be reset at the CMU. Against that, the open NOK 566m ETM claim on Bane NOR is about a third of the market cap and its resolution would skew the outcome upward. So p_up is 47, and the findings sum to -1.0 because the two guidance findings outweigh the small positives.

findings.finding: The FY2026 revenue guide of ~NOK 7.5bn (CER) needs H2 revenue of about NOK 4.66bn against H2 2025's ~NOK 3.57bn (FY25 6.6bn minus 9M25 4.845bn plus Q3 25 1.818bn), up roughly 30% y/y, after H1 2026 fell 6% y/y. A guide cut at Q3 is probable, but the 3-analyst consensus of NOK 6.73bn already sits ~10% below the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (revenue down y/y, guide held, ramp promised): -13.71%. Q3 2025 (revenue down 14% y/y, 'robust revenue growth expected from Q2 2026'): 0.0%. Q4 2025 (first FY26 guide): -5.08%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus is already below the guide, so a cut to around NOK 6.8-7.0bn would not lower estimates. What is not priced is the headline itself on a thin, 3-analyst name; if the market had fully discounted it, the stock would not be trading at 9.96 NOK, near Pareto's bullish framing (TP 12.50 raised 21 Oct).
findings.independence: Consensus FY26 revenue 6.73bn, MarketScreener (https://sa.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/NRC-GROUP-ASA-1413096/) and Twelve Data (https://twelvedata.com/markets/641256/stock/ose/nrc/analysis); FY25 base from https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=666009

findings.finding: The NOK 566m ETM final claim against Bane NOR (about 33% of the ~NOK 1.72bn market cap) had an issuer objective of 'a constructive solution by end of third quarter'. No inside-information release on ETM appears on NewsWeb through 4 Nov, so the Q3 report is the first scheduled status update: either a settlement disclosed with the report (a large positive for cash) or a missed deadline (mildly negative).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Failed ETM mediation in 2025 led to legal proceedings (https://www.inderes.se/en/releases/nrc-etm-update-no-agreement-reached-in-mediation-will-initiate-legal-proceedings); no clean single-day reaction isolated. The AGN Haga final settlement (2026-05-01) came out separately, before Q1.
findings.why_not_priced: The outcome is binary and not yet disclosed. MAR would normally force a separate release for a settlement, and none exists, which lowers the chance of one landing in the report; that is why this is sized small. Part of the claim may already be booked: Norway's 10.5% Q2 margin was 'supported by... successful project completion, including ETM', so a settlement below book would be a write-down. Net size is kept small.
findings.independence: Q2 report: 'A settlement will have a significant positive impact on the company's cash position' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679568); same issuer, not independent

findings.finding: Underlying profitability is rising. Q2 EBIT was NOK 61m after a NOK 71m one-off, so about NOK 132m (7.7%) underlying, with Norway at 10.5%, Finland 7.3% and Machines 21.8%. That supports Q3 EBIT above last year's NOK 65m and keeps the >3% FY margin guide reachable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 margin improvement despite the one-off: +1.53% on the day, +5.16% the next.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Consensus Q3 EPS of 0.31 against 0.17 already assumes the improvement, so this is sized near zero; it lands inside the company's own margin guide.

findings.finding: Q3 order flow disclosed on NewsWeb was small: SEK 70m (2 Sep), EUR 25m (10 Sep), SEK 49m (11 Sep), NOK 38m (28 Sep), roughly NOK 0.45bn announced. Against ~NOK 1.9bn of quarterly revenue, Q3 book-to-bill probably lands below 1x and backlog falls q/q, before the HERI2 EUR 59.2m award, which only counts in Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 book-to-bill 0.5x: 0.0% reaction (buyback announced the same day).
findings.why_not_priced: Each award was public, but nobody aggregates them into a quarterly book-to-bill. Q3 is seasonally weak (0.5x last year) and the HERI2 award gives a Q4 offset, so this is sized small.

findings.finding: The Chair (Ståle Rodahl) bought 200,000 shares at NOK 8.34 on 26 Aug 2026 and a board member bought 18,750 at NOK 8.00 on 20 Aug, while ETM talks were starting. Insiders bought during the negotiation window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose 8.3% the day after the Chair's purchase was disclosed (27 Aug).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the stock is 19% above the purchase price. Kept small as a signal about management's view of H2.

findings.finding: The CMU will cover 'Status on first half of strategy period' and 'outlook second half'. The 2028 targets (>NOK 10bn revenue, >5% EBIT) stand against 2027 consensus revenue of NOK 7.02bn and net income of NOK 144m, so a revenue-target reset is likely the same morning.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The previous CMU (with Q1 2024, 23 May 2024) introduced the 2028 targets; no reaction is isolated in the baseline. The last two prints that leaned on the H2 ramp story fell (-5.08%, -13.71%).
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus already sits far below the 2028 revenue path, so the numbers are discounted. The open question is whether management holds the 5% margin target while trimming revenue (neutral to positive) or cuts both (negative). The range is wide and the centre leans slightly negative.
findings.independence: 2027 consensus from MarketScreener (https://sa.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/NRC-GROUP-ASA-1413096/); 2028 targets in Q2 report (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=679568). This is a different line from finding 1 (2028 vs 2026) but rests on the same revenue-shortfall evidence

findings.finding: The term loan (maturing Q3 2027) and bond (Q4 2027) are in a refinancing process that began by Q2. No bond issue appears on NewsWeb, so a completed or terms-agreed refinancing could be presented at the CMU and would remove a 2027 maturity overhang.
findings.why_not_priced: Refinancing existing debt buys runway, not a ramp. NIBD of NOK 781m against equity ratio 38% is not distressed, so this is small either way.

findings.finding: Norway's 2027 state budget (Prop. 1 S 2026-2027, 7 Oct) raises rail operations and maintenance but lowers 'fornying og mindre investeringar' against 2026, according to a search snippet of the government's county overview. Renewal is a line NRC Norway's rail division bids on, so this is a mild headwind for the CMU outlook.
findings.original_quote: snippet_only: the page returned 403 to WebFetch, so the original sentence could not be quoted; the search snippet paraphrased a higher allocation to drift og vedlikehald (NOK 7.9bn) and a lower one to fornying og mindre investeringar (NOK 7.2bn) for 2027
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission. Norway is only about 22% of Q2 revenue (368m of 1,704m) and the ministry also says rail investment rises (https://www.regjeringen.no/no/aktuelt/regjeringa-foreslar-a-auke-loyvingane-til-investeringar-pa-jernbana/id3175558/). It is a hypothesis, not a company number, so it is sized near zero.

findings.finding: The Gunnar Knutsen strategic review (started Q1 2026; unit H1 revenue NOK 178m, EBIT NOK 21m) is unresolved, and the company said it 'will communicate further when appropriate'. A sale outcome or update at the CMU would release capital.
findings.why_not_priced: No transaction disclosed; a binding sale would require an inside-information release, and none exists, so it may only be a status update. Kept small.
